semantic_roundtrip.remaining_semantic_delta: Accepted only for the explicitly scoped derived targets, as independently reviewed. No source statement is repaired on the basis of an implementation failure. A probability space, measurable natural-indexed real observations with common law and AE support in[0,1] produce the attained expected fixed minimum Tv. All-time input hypotheses are explicit. Independence is unnecessary for this fixed minimum or known-law constant mean. Causal excess additionally uses mutual independence and deterministic measurable strict-history policies, feasible on legal histories only. Their L2/current-target independence are produced internally; Q004 separately assumes these consumer premises. Q006 uses existing half-initialized past-mean prediction. Q008 requires positive T, retains unused policy-context premises and proves finite normalization only. T=0 extensions belong to unnormalized results without uniqueness. No expectation/minimum interchange, arbitrary-prediction nonnegativity, general randomized/filtration coverage, asymptotic or whole-chapter acceptance is claimed. Twelve missing historical hash uses across seven digests remain OPEN with original owners/statuses.
